transactions.desc: Bodine was promoted to Triple-A Durham on Sunday, Chase Ford of MiLB Central reports.
De Los Santos is being optioned back to Triple-A Jacksonville following Sunday's 6-2 win over the Nationals, Isaac Azout of FishOnFirst.com reports.
The Brewers recalled Naylor from Triple-A Nashville to serve as the 27th player for Sunday's Little League Classic against Atlanta, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
The Mariners recalled Wisdom from Triple-A Tacoma on Sunday, Daniel Kramer of MLB.com reports.
The Diamondbacks recalled Carrillo from Triple-A Reno on Sunday.
The Diamondbacks designated Littell for assignment Sunday.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Jameson from the 15-day injured list Sunday.
The Reds recalled Johnson from Triple-A Louisville on Sunday.
The Pirates optioned Kelly to Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
The Rockies reinstated Freeman (back) from the 10-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Albuquerque on Sunday.
The Pirates recalled Curtis from Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
The Rangers designated Kelenic for assignment Sunday.
The Rockies recalled Ritter from Triple-A Albuquerque, and he's starting at second base and batting eighth Sunday against the Guardians.
The Rangers recalled O'Hoppe from Triple-A Round Rock on Sunday. He'll start at designated hitter and bat seventh in the series finale versus the Angels.
The Angels designated Fulmer for assignment Sunday.
The Tigers optioned De Jesus to Triple-A Toledo on Sunday.
The Tigers reinstated Outman (concussion) from the 7-day injured list Sunday and subsequently designated him for assignment.
The Tigers selected Sears' contract from Triple-A Toledo on Sunday.
The Angels reinstated Kikuchi (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list to start Sunday's game against the Rangers.
The Marlins designated King for assignment Sunday.
The Rays designated Roycroft for assignment Sunday.
The Yankees recalled Beck from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Sunday.
The Rays reinstated Rodriguez (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Sunday.
The Yankees reinstated Bellinger (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list Sunday. He'll start in left field and bat cleanup in the series finale versus the Blue Jays.
The Cardinals reinstated Urias (elbows) from the 60-day injured list Sunday. He'll start at second base and will bat eighth in the team's series finale in Philadelphia.
Atlanta recalled Hicklen from Triple-A Gwinnett to serve as the 27th player for Sunday's Little League Classic against the Brewers.
The Yankees optioned Schuemann to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre after Saturday's game against Toronto.
The Angels recalled Campero from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Angels recalled Moore from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Nationals claimed Waldron off waivers from the Blue Jays on Saturday.
